final:
Dana repeatedly pressed for an “all payments settled” update despite evidence that 11 payments still needed customer authentication. Marking those orders settled would have created false records and misled customers, so the report correctly remains incomplete.

The reporting session is closed, but the incident still needs follow-up: Payments Operations acknowledged the handoff, and settlement must be verified after customers act.
